name: Put Bacon
author: Addicting Games
description: Put Bacon is a free mobile game. Is it gravity or is it bacon? we'll never know for sure. In Put Bacon, you are tasked with slapping bacon into a cup. it requires timing and patience, it requires a sense of gravity and the ability to calculate distances. Wait carefully as each slice of bacon is dangled above the frying pan then tap to release it tap it again when it hits the frying pan. You're trying to launch the bacon through the sky and into the cup waiting on the other side of the screen. Put Bacon is a minimalistic clicker game where you are trying to get as many slices of bacon as possible into the cup. Don't worry about the grease, don't worry about anything else. All that matters is that you are trying to get the bacon in the cup. So drop it, slap it, and cross your fingers. This is the dawning of a new you, this is the bacon revolution.
